name: Renewing your strength
promise: Six days to trade exhaustion and discouragement for inward fire, spiritual rest and the quiet strength of abiding in Christ.
why: Relentless pressure, delayed answers and constant pouring out can drain even a sincere believer until the heart feels ready to faint. Across six days, Apostle Arome Osayi teaches how the Holy Spirit keeps an unquenchable fire burning within, quiets the anxious soul in prayer, refreshes the weary through spiritual rest and sustains long obedience without burnout.

days.theme: An inward fire circumstances cannot quench
days.key_quote: When everybody is discouraged, even you still have the stab knife on your heart, but you are raging. And everyone is wondering if you are still human. Yes, you are. But there is something burning inside of you that the circumstances don't have authority to quench.

days.theme: Endurance when the journey feels heavy
days.key_quote: This journey of faith is a journey of endurance, because what the word is doing is the word is bringing pressure upon us.

When you have understanding, you are delivered from anxiety. When you have understanding, several people might think you are suffering, but because you have understanding, you have an armor that makes you positive in the midst of the circumstances.

days.theme: Drawing rest and refreshing in the Spirit
days.key_quote: It is when you have received interpretation of tongues you have spoken that rest comes. This is the rest and this is the refreshment.

days.theme: Avoiding burnout by abiding in Christ
days.key_quote: The strategy that is needed in order to avoid burnout is what we call the principle of abiding. That was the principle that Jesus was trying to uncover in the book of John chapter 15. And we must take advantage of our mystical union with Christ and abide therein.

There is a crown of glory that is set ahead of you. So let your heart not faint. Don't take offense about a negative feedback. How that one of the people you've been protecting with your gifts, with your capacity, now turns around to bite you, turns around to backbite you, turns around to fight with you. Don't be moved by that, because the one fighting you is not the one going to reward you.
